examples.quote: Does restricting young-parent reproductive opportunities delay the first subsequent birth, and does it change the population difference between a policy mixture and balanced single-policy controls? The previous dose pilot tracked only parents who had been blocked, omitted sham parents from that follow-up and used a setting with frequent bottlenecks. This study enters each individual at their first energy-, age- and cap-eligible opportunity while younger than 50, irrespective of that opportunity's gate decision, including sham. Track birth, death, energy and end of observation. Births on the entry tick have elapsed time zero. Because population histories diverge, the individuals entering a cohort under different doses are post-intervention populations; dose-specific timing contrasts are descriptive intervention outcomes, not individual-level counterfactual postponement or natural mediation estimates.
